Content inside <template> is never rendered per the HTML spec and must not appear in the output

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>visible</p><template><p>secret template text</p></template><p>also visible</p>");
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
